How I work

With a background in Computer Engineering, I work at the intersection of creativity and technology, turning ideas into meaningful digital experiences, functional systems, and solutions that solve real problems.

From shaping an idea and designing its experience to developing, deploying, and maintaining the final product, I enjoy being involved in the entire process. I believe good technology should do more than work — it should make things better, simpler, and more meaningful.

I'm constantly exploring new ideas, experimenting with different approaches, and pushing beyond what I already know.

I don't just want to build what's expected. I want to build what's possible.
